Priya (Finance): FYI — need final sign-off on the Q2 pricing experiment grandfathering exceptions before we flip the A/B split tomorrow morning. Putting list + ask below.
Oliver (Revenue): ack. can you paste the customer list here or link the sheet?
Jamal (Billing): Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEF_example - added a "reason" column for exceptions.
Priya (Finance): Copy. Main asks: (1) approve all 12 exceptions (they keep legacy rate) (2) confirm rollback window & notify SAs (3) confirm billing sys can accept the override CSV.
BillingBot: [automated] Invoice scan detected 3 customers with mismatched rates vs ledger: cust_401, cust_587, cust_612 — flagged for manual review.
Oliver (Revenue): I'll take cust_401 & cust_587. Jamal can you look at cust_612?
Jamal (Billing): on it. note: cust_612 has a pending credits dispute — might explain mismatch.
Ana (Legal): quick legal note — any changes that preserve existing rates for these customers need to be captured in amendment docs. send me the list + effective dates and I'll fast-track.
Leo (Finance Ops): I can generate the override CSV and run a dry import. sample CSV:
```csv
customer_id,old_rate_id,new_rate_id,effective_date,comment
cust_401,legacy-2023,payg-q2,2026-04-01,grandfathered-exception
cust_587,legacy-2023,payg-q2,2026-04-01,grandfathered-exception
cust_612,legacy-2023,payg-q2,2026-04-01,grandfathered-exception
```
Priya (Finance): perfect. timeline: final approval by 16:00 PT today, dry-run 18:00 PT, go-live 02:00 PT tomorrow. can everyone confirm?
Oliver (Revenue): approve for my two.
Jamal (Billing): approve.
Ana (Legal): approve pending amendment sign-off; share list by 15:30 PT and I'll confirm.
BillingBot: [automated] Next billing run in 12h — any manual fixes must be applied before midnight UTC to avoid proration issues.
Priya (Finance): noted. @Leo please queue the dry-run and send logs to #billing for visibility. thanks :thumbsup:
Leo (Finance Ops): will do. :eyes:
Priya (Finance): closing thread — if anything blocks, ping me directly.
